arxiv-2112-09931.title: Simple Relationships Between Lozenge Tiling Functions of Related Regions
arxiv-2112-09931.creator: Daniel Condon
arxiv-2112-09931.description: Abstract We give a formula for the number of symmetric tilings of hexagons on the triangular lattice with unit triangles removed from arbitrary positions along two non-adjacent non-opposite sides. We show that for certain families of such regions, the ratios of their numbers of symmetric tilings are given by simple product formulas.

arxiv-2208-07661.title: Rashba contribution of 2D Dirac-Weyl fermions: Beyond ordinary quantum regime
arxiv-2208-07661.creator: Ahmed Jellal, Dariush Jahani, Omid Akhavan
arxiv-2208-07661.description: Abstract We study the energy levels of Dirac-Weyl fermions in graphene subject to a magnetic field with Rashba contribution in the minimal length situation. The exact solution for the energy dispersion of Dirac-like charge carriers coupled to the magnetic moments in a (2+1)-dimension is obtained by the use of the momentum space representation.

arxiv-2209-01727.title: Maximal coin-position entanglement generation in a quantum walk for the third step and beyond regardless of the initial state
arxiv-2209-01727.creator: Xiao-Xu Fang, Kui An, Bai-Tao Zhang, Barry C. Sanders, He Lu
arxiv-2209-01727.description: Abstract We study maximal coin-position entanglement generation via a discrete-time quantum walk, in which the coin operation is randomly selected from one of two coin operators set at each step. We solve maximal entanglement generation as an optimization problem with quantum process fidelity as the cost function.

arxiv-2212-00225.title: Nonreciprocal Phonon Propagation in a Metallic Chiral Magnet
arxiv-2212-00225.creator: T. Nomura, X.-X. Zhang, R. Takagi, K. Karube, A. Kikkawa, Y. Taguchi, Y. Tokura, S. Zherlitsyn, Y. Kohama, S. Seki
arxiv-2212-00225.description: Abstract The phonon magnetochiral effect (MChE) is the nonreciprocal acoustic and thermal transports of phonons caused by the simultaneous breaking of the mirror and time-reversal symmetries. So far, the phonon MChE has been observed only in a ferrimagnetic insulator Cu 2 OSeO 3 , where the nonreciprocal response disappears above the Curie temperature of 58 K.

arxiv-2301-01173.description: Abstract Cooperative localization (CL) is an important technology for innovative services such as location-aware communication networks, modern convenience, and public safety. Belief propagation (BP) is a state-of-the-art Bayesian method for CL.

arxiv-2411-01559.title: Successive Minima, Determinant and Automorphism Groups of Hyperelliptic Function Field Lattices
arxiv-2411-01559.creator: Lilian Menn, Elif Saçıkara
arxiv-2411-01559.description: Abstract In this paper, we contribute to previously known results on lattices constructed by algebraic function fields, or function field lattices in short. First, motivated by the non-well-roundedness property of certain hyperelliptic function field lattices [ 2 ] , we explore the successive minima of these lattices in detail. We also study the determinant of hyperelliptic function field lattices.

arxiv-2602-10058.title: Evaluating Disentangled Representations for Controllable Music Generation
arxiv-2602-10058.creator: Laura Ibáñez-Martínez, Chukwuemeka Nkama, Andrea Poltronieri, Xavier Serra, Martín Rocamora
arxiv-2602-10058.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Laura Ibáñez-Martínez, Chukwuemeka Nkama, Andrea Poltronieri, Xavier Serra, Martín Rocamora. Recent approaches in music generation rely on disentangled representations, often labeled as structure and timbre or local and global , to enable controllable synthesis. Yet the underlying properties of these embeddings remain underexplored. In this work, we evaluate such disentangled representations in a set of music audio models for controllable generation using a probing-based framework that goes beyond standard downstream tasks.

plos-pone-0003146.creator: Wendong Yu, Rajesh Ramakrishnan, Yan Wang et al.
plos-pone-0003146.description: PLOS ONE research article. HIV-1 is dependent upon cellular co-factors to mediate its replication cycle in CD4 + T cells and macrophages, the two major cell types infected by the virus in vivo. pmc-10580975.creator: Yang Zhou, Zhuoying Liu, Jie Wen, Yan Zhou, Huancai Lin
pmc-10580975.description: Streptococcus mutans (S. mutans) is one of the major cariogenic bacteria of dental caries owing to its ability to adhere to tooth surfaces and biofilm formation. However, the effect of BH on S. mutans biofilm has not been reported.
